GENERATE BURST KS-X-visor — Run C-9 P4, M3 last fix (Matt: "the helm flap is too small in South"). task_id "KS-X-visor".

Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1: a sheet of 4 slots of the same knight. Change ONLY the HELM VISOR of the figure in SLOT 1 (leftmost, facing the viewer): it is too small — a thin band. Make it the full-size visor that the other figures on this sheet wear (slots 2-4, and IMAGE 2's front-diagonal view): a large, smooth, rounded visor plate covering the whole face from brow to chin, projecting slightly forward, crossed by a single row of small round holes, with the same dark gouache steel. The skull above it stays as it is.
Keep EVERYTHING ELSE EXACTLY as it is: slots 2-4 untouched; slot 1's body, tabard, heraldry, pollaxe, pose; positions; flat pure #00ff00 background. For this step the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY THE IMAGES: do not restyle.

Two image_gen EDIT calls: variants a and b. ONE retry per variant only if slot 1's visor is still small, anything outside slot 1's visor changed, or the background is not flat green — name the reason. Copy outputs to out/KS-X-visor_a.png and out/KS-X-visor_b.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "KS-X-visor"; images = the files with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — THE SHEET TO EDIT (change only slot 1's visor)
IMAGE 2 — the same knight; slot 4 (lower-right diagonal) shows the full-size visor
